paite: Huan nang, mihing tapa, Gog tung ah thu gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ngai in, Aw Gog, Rosh, Meshek leh Tubal heutupen, ka hon dou ahi.
heading: Gog Vuallelhna

paite: Ka hon lehngatsak ding a, ka hon pi zel ding a, mal tawp pek a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, Israel tangte ah ka hon tun ding hi.
Na khut veilam a kipan na thalpeu ka kitansak ding a, na khut taklam a kipan na thalte ka kesak ding hi.
Israel tangte ah na puk ding a, nang leh na sepaihhon tengteng leh na kiang a mipi omte toh, sasial ne vasa chitengte kiang leh gam sahangte kiang ah nekgaih ding in ka hon pe ding hi.
Gamlak ah na puk ding a; ke'n ka chita a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
Magog leh tui gei gam a bittak a tengte tung ah mei ka khah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Huan ka mi Israelte lak ah ka min siangthou ka hihlang ding a, ka min siangthou hihbuah ka phal nawnta kei ding a; huchi in namte'n kei, TOUPA Israel Mi Siangthoupa ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Ngai un, ahong tung hi; hihtangtun in a-om ngei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; hiai ni ahi ka na gen.

Huan Israel khopi a tengte apawtkhe ding ua, meikuang ah galvante akhul ding ua, akangmang ding; lum lian leh lum neute, thal leh apeute, teipi leh chiangzumte kum sagih sung meikuang ah akhul ding uhi.

Huchi in gam sing apo kei ding ua, gammang singte aphuk kei ding uh, galvante sing khul ding a zang ding uh ahi ngal a; gallak la mite gallak in ala tei ding ua, lok mite alokthuk ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Gog a ding in Israel gam ah vuina mun ka pe ding a, tuipi suahlam, Abarim Phaizang ngei; huai in khualzinte adal ding a, Gog leh alawite avui ding ua; huchi in huai phaizang Hamongog Phaizang asa ding uhi.
heading: Gog Vuina

paite: Huan Israel inkote'n agam uh khuahsiang in kha sagih sung avui ding uh.
Ahi, agam ua mi tengteng in avui ding ua; pahtawi a ka om ni in ka minthanna ahi ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Agam uh khuahsianna ding in, luang vuilouhte teng zongkhia avui ding in nasep a nei ding mi aseptuam ding uh, kha sagih bei nung in azong pan ding uhi.
Gam vel mite'n avel un, mihing guhte amuh uleh chiamtehna abawl ding ua, Hamongog Phaizang a vui mite'n avui ma uh.
Huan Hamonah khopi min ahi ding. Huchibang in gam akhuahsiang ding uhi.

Nang, mihing tapa, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Vasa chichihte leh sa chichihte kiang ah thu gen inla, pungkhawm unla, hong pai un, sa na nek ua sisan na dawntheihna ding un Israel tang a kithoihna thupitak, nou a dia ka bawl kim ah hong kikhawm un.
Mithupi sate na ne ding ua, lei a heutute sisan na dawn ding ua; belamtalte, belamnoute, kelte, Bashan gam a bawngtal vak thau tengteng sisan toh.
Nou a dia kithoihna ankuang ka lui thau, vah kikeih in na ne ding ua; asisan kham khop in na dawn ding uh.
Huchi in sakolte, kangtalai kai mite, mithupite leh galdoumi tengteng in ka ankuang ah na tai ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huchi in namte lak ah ka thupina ka koih ding a, nam tengteng in athugel hihpuksate leh atung ua ka khut khakdante amu ding uh.
heading: Israel Tunding Nawnna

paite: Huai ni a kipan Israel inkote'n kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih atheita ding uh.

Namte'n Israel inkote athulimlouhna ziak un sal in atang uh chih athei ding ua; ka tung a aginom louh mahmah ziak un amau tung ah ka mel ka sel a, huchi in amelmate uh khut ah ka pia a, namsau in apuk vek uhi.
Asianthoulouhna bang zel uleh atatlekna bang zel un atung uah ka hih tei a; amau a kipan ka mel ka sel ahi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Tu'n zaw Jakobte omdan ka hei ding a, Israel inkuan pumpi tung ah zah ka ngai ding, ka min siangthou gum in ka thikthu ase ding hi.
Kuamah lausakmi om lou a, agam ua bittak a aten hun un leng atatlekna tengteng uh, ka tung a atatlekna uh leh azahlakna uh apo ding uhi.
Mite lak a kipan ka pikhiak nawn a, amelmate uh gam a kipan ka kaihkhawm a, amau nam tampi mitmuh a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in.
Huan namte lak a sal a ka tansak nawn a, agam ngei ua ka pikhawm nawndan ah kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih athei ding uh; huai ah alak ua khat lel leng ka nuse kei ding hi.
Amau a kipan ka mel ka sel nawnta kei ding; Israel inkote tung ah ka kha ka sungta ngal a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
